name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: Assign respectively the one-point samples $(x_0,0),(x_1,1),(x_2,1)$ to $000,011,101$. Each sample is inconsistent with both other concepts, so no pair clashes. A zero-size teacher map on a non-singleton class makes every pair clash. Hence $\mathrm{NCTD}=1$; the map is checked in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$.
references: Direct calculation from the class definition; see \cite{KSZ2019} for NCTD.
